notes.md: - **New Zealand – women's vote (1893):** the **Electoral Act** signed on **19 September 1893** made New Zealand the **first self-governing country** where all adult women could vote in parliamentary elections; women first voted on **28 November 1893**.
- **Netherlands – same-sex marriage (2001):** the **first country** to legalise same-sex marriage, from **1 April 2001**; the first weddings were held in **Amsterdam**.

- **Ecuador – rights of nature (2008):** Ecuador's **2008 Constitution** (approved by referendum, September 2008) was the **first national constitution** to recognise the **rights of nature** ("**Pacha Mama**"), in **Articles 71–74**.
